name: TRISTAN
full_name: TRitium Investigation on STerile to Active Neutrino mixing
summary: TRISTAN is the named KATRIN detector upgrade for a high-statistics search for keV-scale sterile neutrinos. It measures a much wider tritium beta-energy range than the standard endpoint neutrino-mass analysis.
detection_principle: A segmented silicon-drift-detector system records electron energies at high rate. A sterile-neutrino admixture would introduce a kink in the differential beta spectrum below the ordinary endpoint.

science_scope: TRISTAN is a named upgrade within KATRIN, not an independent beam or source facility. Its sterile-neutrino search is distinguished from the effective active-neutrino mass measured near the tritium endpoint.
